policy: Initial JavaScript, desktop route and Settings ceilings were lowered after measured P2 reductions. Other reviewed ceilings remain unchanged. The PDF viewer feature ceiling rose from 500000 to 510000 for the PDF.js 6 security upgrade (GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j); the chunk loads only when a PDF is opened. Locale-only ceilings include the existing reviewed 24-language supporter UI expansion, the shared key dictionary and every canonical translated value. Further increases require a performance review. The 4.1.0 performance review adds exactly 9002 canonical locale bytes (0.461%) and 611 bytes to the largest catalog for four caption/reload labels in all 24 locales. Dictionary plus English grows 368 bytes; dictionary plus the largest selected catalog grows 744 bytes, with unchanged loading requests. JavaScript, CSS, route, feature and literal ceilings are unchanged. The Desktop 4.1.3 performance review permits exact measured desktop route (310077 bytes), total locale data (1969806) and largest locale (139976) costs for the Files/Transfers interface, bulk upload retry and translated labels; see Docs/DESKTOP_4.1.3_RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md. Startup JavaScript decreases, route file count stays seven, and other ceilings and lazy loading remain unchanged. The Desktop 4.1.4 performance review permits exact measured desktop route (310269 bytes), total canonical locale data (1970576) and largest locale (140073) for the waiting status and one translated label; see Docs/DESKTOP_4.1.4_RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md. Startup JavaScript, CSS, locked dependencies, packed locale loading and all other ceilings remain unchanged.
